text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim that driverless cars are \"paving the way for a safer future\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a direct, unmistakable position early so the reader immediately knows the argument being made."},{"evidence":"explains danger from intoxicated and reckless drivers with multiple examples","quality":"development of reasons","description":"It supports the main claim with several distinct arguments instead of relying on one brief point."},{"evidence":"mentions construction zones, sensors, cameras, intoxicated drivers, road rage, and pedestrians","quality":"supporting detail","description":"It brings in multiple relevant details that flesh out the argument and connect it to real driving problems."},{"evidence":"repeated cause-and-effect statements like delayed reactions leading to danger","quality":"logical elaboration","description":"It explains how and why the evidence supports the conclusion rather than just listing facts."},{"evidence":"uses transitions such as \"Another issue\" and \"By resolving issues\"","quality":"organization","description":"It moves through the argument in a clear sequence that helps the essay feel structured and coherent."},{"evidence":"conclusion restates safety claim and returns to the opening idea","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"It ends by reinforcing the position in a way that wraps up the argument clearly."}]}
